analysis_demo.input_requirement: registered frozen test X and aligned row_map; no supplied features
analysis_demo.interpretation: Accepted offline evaluation; frozen t0 replay is not an actual deployed prediction

value.reason: V4原始Brier差严格<0.001的候选中，按预登记简洁性次序选首项；不并回V4重训

evaluation.input_requirement: registered frozen test X and aligned row_map; no supplied features
evaluation.interpretation: Accepted offline evaluation; frozen t0 replay is not an actual deployed prediction

coverage_rules.complete_union: current complete intervals must cover the whole window; adjacent and overlapping intervals merge
coverage_rules.confirmation_order: watermark.checked_at>=max checked_at of ALL current complete intervals overlapping the window
coverage_rules.conflicts: required source with conflicting interval boundaries/latest states/latest watermarks is incomplete
coverage_rules.evidence_visibility: checked_at<=as_of and available_at<=as_of before retransmission/version/conflict handling
coverage_rules.known_gap: any positive-length overlap with a current gap blocks completeness; a different complete interval cannot repair it
coverage_rules.limits: provided evidence supports completeness; no proof of absence of invisible upstream loss
coverage_rules.version_selection: maximum checked_at, not upload time or historical maximum watermark
coverage_rules.window: only qualified combinations create [t0,t0+72h); otherwise not_applicable

public_context.meaning: 已确认取得资格、观察窗口成熟且完整无异常的用户×剧情组合中，72小时内未开始目标剧情的比例

states.Q0: 资格未知，或已确认资格但缺少必要资格时间
states.Q2: 已确认资格但观察窗口尚未成熟；即使已开始也保留Q2
states.Q3: 已成熟但覆盖不完整，或存在早于t0的可见目标开始异常
states.Q4: 成熟、完整且无异常，窗内至少一次有效开始
states.Q5: 成熟、完整且无异常，窗内没有有效开始

time_rules.as_of: registered main snapshot; no current-clock fallback
time_rules.event_retransmission: same event_id and business content count once; conflicting visible content is an input error
time_rules.event_visibility: event_time<=as_of and available_at<=as_of; then deduplicate event_id
time_rules.format: UTC ISO 8601; Z or +00:00; invalid or missing timezone rejected
time_rules.qualification: use consistent visible first-met evidence; historical not_met does not prove current not_qualified
time_rules.qualification_time_conflict: qualified necessary times later than as_of are an input error

check_quality.description: Check qualification and observation evidence at registered main snapshots.

compare_results.description: Compare two authorized single-version metric evidence objects.

count_differences.description: Right minus left integers even with null rates; all count differences are null when either group is absent.

get_evidence.description: Retrieve aggregate evidence authorized in this session; no individual artifacts.

inspect_context.description: Read approved M03 meaning, grain, Q states, time/coverage rules, table fields and source bindings; metadata only.

predict_registered.description: Replay the registered frozen model on authorized frozen test X.

query_metric.description: Calculate registered M03 from complete candidates and observed evidence.

read_model_card.description: Read a role-authorized, source-bound model card.
